note: Four AI-assisted, source-and-independent-benchmark CROSSCHECKS only; no external clinical, financial or human independent reviewer signed off. These are partial research-only 0-100 metric bands, not full 30/30 stage scores, FDA probabilities or investments signals. Future fully independent review remains separately required.

records.benchmarkId: Published omalizumab UAS7 randomized clinical precedent, not comparative efficacy ranking
records.benchmarkContext: Independent published 2017 randomized CSU study reports UAS7 between-group difference -14.82 at week 12 in a small study (20 active, 10 placebo). Different trials, drugs, population and analyses: not a head-to-head benchmark.
records.observedResult: Sponsor 2026-09-22 8-K shows NCT06445023 150 mg Q4W barzolvolimab Week-12 UAS7 LS mean changes active -20.2 versus placebo -10.7, giving 9.5 UAS7 points more reduction; company states p<0.00001.
records.uncertaintyReview: Source reports arm-level LS mean standard errors, but public topline does not establish independently reanalyzed CI for the treatment contrast, complete SAP, multiplicity/sensitivity analyses or head-to-head efficacy. Evidence strength is provisional.
records.criticalRiskReview: Different-study omalizumab UAS7 effect is contextual only and cannot prove superiority; ensure durability, blinded source verification, attrition, safety and regulatory package before full RAAS.
records.reviewerMethod: AI-assisted comparison of dated issuer SEC exhibit with independently published randomized CSU study. No external human reviewer, clinical validation or FDA decision audit. Research-only provisional mixed band.

records.benchmarkId: Published ASTERIA omalizumab UAS7 equals zero responder proportions as historical context
records.benchmarkContext: Published randomized omalizumab CSU results reported UAS7=0 at week 12 of 35.8% versus 8.8% placebo in ASTERIA I and 44.3% versus 5.1% in ASTERIA II. Historical separate-study ranges cannot establish comparative superiority.
records.observedResult: Sponsor 2026-09-22 8-K lists NCT06445023 Week-12 UAS7=0 complete response 150 mg Q4W 42.4% vs placebo 9.3%, an absolute 33.1 percentage-point difference, p<0.00001 per sponsor.
records.uncertaintyReview: Complete absence of itch and hives is a patient-important responder endpoint, but confidence intervals, missing-data sensitivity, validated QoL outcomes and population-adjusted comparisons to active therapies need independent assessment.
records.criticalRiskReview: Cross-trial response comparisons are vulnerable to differing baseline severity, eligibility and concomitant therapies; no clinical ranking against omalizumab or chance of approval is justified.
records.reviewerMethod: AI-assisted exact-NCT sponsor SEC exhibit extraction and independent peer-reviewed historical CSU response reference; no external human adjudication or full clinical grade. Research-only provisional mixed band.
